gameplay.existing_baseline: Existing properties and buildings receive canonical existing-development permission and completion/use records; these are not represented as newly filed applications or invented historical site visits.
gameplay.finance_boundary: No fees, charges, invoices, payments, contracts or financial commitments are created; BP-34 owns transactions.
gameplay.future_play: Player-controlled development applications, objections, decisions, construction inspections, enforcement and completion events are created as runtime events when gameplay occurs.
gameplay.people_boundary: No applicants as individuals, contractors, occupants, residents or other person records are created.
